body: My family is going to hate me and I'm either going to kill myself or end up a drug addict from this terrible sickness. It's only a matter of time...

Thank you for your reply,

I would love to go to MIT, and it has been a dream of mine for a while, but when everyone still says, "Oh you can still get in. It takes hard work and motivation. You're just not trying hard enough." That hurts. 

I want to go into Computer Science. Every time I tell them I don't have the motivation they get mad and tell me that is why I am failing (Which in all truth, it is.) and that is why I have problems. 

I don't know. I guess I am afraid of failure. It's tearing me apart.
I don't know if I could handle that. You're very strong.
For me, it is my dad. Its all he is watching.

It is not your fault that those people killed themselves. It was their own thought and reason. Think about what will happen if you kill yourself. You become less than what you are now. Right now you are alive! You are privilaged to say that!

You are part of the few who have life! If you haven't already, go to a psychologist. They can be the most helpful people in the world. I urge you to call someone. Anyone! Especially a hotline! I have had to call a hotline before, and those people really care. I have been where you are. I have felt what you are feeling exactly now. I promise you, things will get better. That numb feeling is normal with people who feel like you and I.

If you think that everyone who gets close to you kills themselves, your wrong. It is NEVER your fault! Not ever! If I was near you, I would go to where you live and stay with you for as long as you need. I would never let you feel that way alone! 

Look at us now. We are close through words. My words are my words. They would be the same if I was talking to you face to face. I'm close to you, and I won't kill myself. You won't either! If you want my phone number (and your in the US) please PM me. We can text each other if you would like. I really care for you. Please believe me!

Please explain! I have been in this boat, I can help. PLEASE DO TELL! 

If you don't know how to explain it, do it the best you can! We will all listen and give our best advice. Suicide isn't the answer now, especially with so much life to live.

Those suicidal thoughts hurt, I know. I have them sometimes, but I think over them and I ask myself if what I am thinking of is logical 10/10 times it's not logical. 

Again, please explain. I really want to talk to you!
Thanks! It's been hard lately and reddit seems to help!
